ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous high-intensity white region spanning the outer half, interspersed with dark mottled spots. The right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black, featuring a single isolated high-intensity circular focal spot and high-intensity pixels along the distal trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse central V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 145 degrees; notch base is well-defined and centered.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetric serration; left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with low-amplitude undulations; right lobe exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged peaks (serrations) near the tip and a deep, irregular traumatic indentation roughly 30% along the lobe length from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, with the right lobe displaying a sharper upward vertical displacement compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A single, prominent high-contrast white circular rosette (donut shape) localized in the lower-central region of the dark right lobe; additional cluster of white punctate spots at the extreme right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, dark, parallel diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white region of the left lobe's outer half.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular notch/void on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, indicative of tissue loss; distinct circular scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of prominent parallel rake marks on the left lobe and a highly specific 'donut' scar on the right lobe provides a unique visual fingerprint.
